profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Sekady
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer with 14 years of experience in the Semiconductor industry creating and supporting manufacturing software for internal use. I am a Full Stack developer with focus on frontend development and design. I enjoy working as part of a team and building strong relationships with coworkers and customers. I love the challenge of troubleshooting issues and solving problems to make life easier for those around me.

Specialties: C#, WPF

positions.title: Senior IT Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked in Manufacturing IT as part of an Agile team with a concentration on the Photo Area. The team followed scrum for 4 years and transitioned to scrumban a year ago. Participated in and occasionally led the following agile ceremonies: Daily Standup, Sprint Planning, Retrospective, and Demo.
• Full Stack developer with focus on frontend development and design (C#, WPF, XAML, MVVM, MSSQL database).
• Developed close working relationships with internal customers worldwide. Helped to write User Stories based on customer wants/needs. Traveled to Asia several times as part of project deployment to train onsite IT team and provide local troubleshooting assistance.
• Co-architected, developed and deployed a 6-month project with estimated ROI to the company of $200+ million.
• Heavy contributor to TFS/ADO Steering Team helping to define and follow standard practices on git management, build and release pipeline across Manufacturing IT.
• Created Release management and UAT process flow utilized by my team for the last 2 years to address issues we were seeing with keeping track of pending software releases and clearly signing off UAT for stories.
• Mentored new hires to the team in process flow, development standards, agile practices and release management .
• Helped with Product Owner role and performed User Acceptance Testing for an internal team that maintained deployment software used by our department (2 years).

positions.title: IT Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on a team to build and maintain a software suite used internally by engineers to extract and analyze data. Main language used: C#, MSSQL
• Spent 2 years in an operations role supporting Engineering applications through support tickets that were escalated to the team and small bug fix and enhancements.
• Became an expert on an internally developed C# framework for UIs, Business Objects and Server development. 
• Co-taught training of framework to other developers. Participated in a developer community for the framework, presenting regularly and led the team for a year.
• Lead UI standards team for 3 years & participated on the team for 8 years to develop and enforce UI standard practices across Manufacturing IT apps.
• Mentored an intern and several new hires during my time on the team.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
• Worked in the Astrogeology department supporting an image processing software suite used by NASA to process 
images returned from their space shuttle cameras. Main language used: C++
• Converted applications from Perl and Fortran to C++ and wrote new applications and classes in C++
• Solved user problems through an online support board and wrote “how to” documents for users to follow
